status: development target; compile-tested only, no hardware acceptance

port.method: git am of the 6.18-ps4-baikal series onto v6.18.44 (MTS2 with git apply), cherry-picked onto v7.2.11, then the port fixes; exported with scripts/export-port72-baikal

patches.subject: x86: add PS4 platform support (Linux 6.15)
x86/ps4: pre-allocate IRQ 9 desc for ACPI SCI handler
acpi/osl: PS4 - revert SCI install to non-threaded request_irq
drivers/ps4: add Aeolia/Belize/Baikal southbridge drivers
drivers/ps4: fix bpcie-icc ioread/iowrite pointer types
drivers/ps4: make bpcie_uart_init failure non-fatal in probe
drivers/ps4: Option E v9 - MSI parent routing + Baikal-magic compose_msg
drivers/ps4: Option F v11 - bpcie southbridge MSI config (func extract fix)
drivers/ps4: v12 - revert bpcie compose_msg to kernel default
drivers/ps4: v19 - ICC polling fallback
drm/amdgpu: add PS4 Liverpool bridge and CIK quirks
patches.note: Linux 7.2 makes Display Core the default on CIK and dropped the non-DC CIK case this patch extended. Liverpool and Gladius get their own case that keeps DC opt-in (amdgpu_dc > 0), as in 6.18. The GART size is set with the new amdgpu_gmc_set_gart_size(), SZ_512M for Liverpool and Gladius.

patches.subject: drm/radeon: add PS4 Liverpool support to legacy radeon driver
patches.note: radeon_pci_probe() now passes dev rather than &pdev->dev to devm_drm_dev_alloc().

patches.subject: drm/amdkfd: PS4 CIK / Liverpool quirks
drm: bridge/pciids updates for PS4
patches.note: Linux 7.2 renamed the bridge chain helpers' first argument to first_bridge, and its drm_for_each_bridge_in_chain*() now hold encoder->bridge_chain_mutex and bridge references. The legacy helpers this patch restores still walk encoder->bridge_chain without them, as in 6.18, which had neither.

patches.subject: amdgpu: v15 - require MSI/MSI-X for PS4 Liverpool IRQs
amdgpu: v20 - skip DP link training for Liverpool/Gladius
amdgpu: v21 - force ps4_bridge init at attach time
amdgpu: v22 - ps4_bridge default to VIC 16 + permissive mode_valid
amdgpu: v24 - ps4_bridge mode_fixup forces 1080p60
amdgpu: v25 - remove 1080p120 mode, mark 1080p60 preferred
amdgpu: v28 - dce_v8_0 fallback adjusted_clock to mode->clock
amdgpu: v31 - remove bridge_disable to keep HDMI signal
amdgpu: v32 - msleep(500) at bridge_enable for DP TX settle
amdgpu: rename ProcessI2cChannelTransaction -> ReadEDIDFromHWAssistedI2C
amdgpu: v47 - floor dp_clock=270000 on Liverpool/Gladius in adjust_pll
amdgpu: v49 - clobber dp_extclk on Liverpool so picker selects a real PPLL
amdgpu: v52 - floor dig_connector dp_clock + dp_lane_count for Liverpool
amdgpu: v59 - skip TX DISABLE on Liverpool DP to preserve firmware-trained link
amdgpu: v60 - also skip TX ENABLE on Liverpool DP
drm/ps4: adapt bridge attach callback to Linux 6.18
drm/amdgpu/ps4: use the 6.18 managed bridge lifetime
amdgpu: add pointer-safe bridge CQ and lane diagnostics
amdgpu: restore proven MN864729 command-stage boundaries
ata/ahci: PS4 internal HDD quirks (Linux 6.15)
patches.note: Linux 7.2 rewrote ahci_pci_tbl with designated initializers; the three Sony entries use that style and stay between Enmotus and Loongson.

patches.subject: ata/ahci: port the current rmux Baikal storage path
patches.note: ahci_baikal_shared_phy_seeded() follows the new ahci_validate_bar_size(). Linux 7.2 calls that check after pcim_iomap(), before the Baikal SATA PHY setup, so this probe reads HOST_CAP and can fail with -ENODEV earlier than in 6.18.

patches.subject: mmc: sdhci-pci: PS4 host controller quirks
mmc: sdhci-pci: route Baikal IRQs through bpcie
mt76x8: import MediaTek MT7668 vendor driver from 5.4-baikal
net: wireless: mt76x8/MT6632: fix dev_addr API and pointer type errors for 6.15+
net: wireless: mt76x8: fix build for Linux 6.15+
ps4: disable MediaTek WiFi power save
net/wireless/mt76x8: fix fortified copy_from_user build error
mt76x8: port to cfg80211 / fs API in Linux 6.15+
mt76x8: adapt cfg80211 callbacks to Linux 6.18 radio_idx
usb/xhci: add Aeolia/Baikal xHCI controller
usb/xhci-aeolia: use Baikal-correct shutdown path
usb: xhci-aeolia: add Baikal settle delays before USB bring-up
usb: xhci-aeolia: route Baikal IRQ through apcie_assign_irqs
usb: xhci-aeolia: replace printk timing hack with usleep
hwmon: fam15h_power/k10temp: recognise PS4 APU
iommu/amd: PS4 init quirks (Linux 6.15)
iommu/amd: fix PS4 Baikal coherent DMA
patches.note: Linux 7.2 moved amd_iommu_flush_iotlb_all() and amd_iommu_iotlb_sync(), which followed the new helper in 6.18.

patches.subject: pci/msi/irqdomain: PS4 vendor quirks (Linux 6.15)
patches.note: Linux 7.2 removed pci_msi_create_irq_domain() and its helpers from this hunk's context; ps4-bpcie uses its own copy, see the bpcie port fix.

patches.subject: pci: gate phantom Sony-device filtering to PS4
patches.note: The new includes follow <trace/events/pci.h>, added in Linux 7.2.

patches.subject: net: add continuous polled Baikal MTS module
ps4: icc: use strscpy_pad() for the adapter name
patches.note: Linux 7.2 removed strncpy(). Same change as 7.2-ps4 0169.

patches.subject: mt76x8: replace strncpy() removed in Linux 7.2
patches.note: kalStrnCpy() keeps strncpy() semantics; some callers fill length-delimited firmware fields. Same change as 7.2-ps4 0170.

patches.subject: mt76x8: adapt remain_on_channel to Linux 7.2
patches.note: Upstream 4dbd1829045e added rx_addr; the driver does not set NL80211_EXT_FEATURE_ROC_ADDR_FILTER. Same change as 7.2-ps4 0171.

patches.subject: ps4: bpcie: replace pci_msi_create_irq_domain() removed in Linux 7.2
patches.note: Applies the flags, chip flag and bus token the 6.18 helper set before msi_create_irq_domain(); the 7.2 MSI core functions it relies on are unchanged from 6.18.

patches.subject: mt76x8: adapt key and station operations to Linux 7.1
patches.note: Linux 7.1 passes key and station operations a wireless_dev. The adapters pass on its net_device and refuse a wireless_dev without one, which cfg80211 never passed before.

config.method: merge_config.sh -m with the mt7668 and usb-ethernet fragments, then make olddefconfig on the patched v7.2.11 tree (GCC 16.2.1); LOCALVERSION changed, then make olddefconfig again
changes: PREEMPT_VOLUNTARY, used by the 6.18 boot, no longer exists on x86; make olddefconfig selects PREEMPT, a behavioural difference from 6.18
NTFS3_FS is limited to m by the new NTFS_FS in Linux 7.2
all other differences are Linux 7.2 Kconfig changes resolved by make olddefconfig

hardware_evidence.this_target: none; the kernel has not been booted
